reduction.primary: reduce_e131.py: reduce_e78.py unchanged with E95's items, card 1's 65/65 config read accepted, dips removed (E82 A2), leakage FROZEN at 0.2414 W/C (E82's own slope on this card; E93's, E124's and E129's frame), E78's gates unchanged
reduction.why_frozen: E112b's registered primary fitted the slope per session (auto): it returned 0.414 and 0.417 W/C, against E82's 0.2414, moving absolute D by about 0.5 W in fp32 and making about half of the gap between the cards (E112 README result 2; 14-card-behaviour.md, 'A session's automatic leakage slope wanders, so register one'); ratios inside a pass are nearly unaffected

arms.auto: leakage auto, dips removed (E112b's registered primary)

reduction.relaxed: reduce_e131.py --relax-anchors --leak 0.2414: the set-aside rule's reduction; always reported

set_aside_rule.written: Mon 2 Nov 2026, in this registration, before the claim and before any E131 data
steps: S1, the primary: E78's pass gates unchanged (each type's zeros line departs <= 0.25 W from its straight line and spans <= 0.60 W; each random anchor spans <= 1.0 W; the pi tie drifts <= 0.60 W; at most 2 failed runs; card 1's config read). It carries every verdict if it keeps >= 3 passes
S2, only if S1 keeps < 3: a pass set aside ONLY by the pi tie's drift is restored whole (pi enters no claim and no cross-card rule, only the reported session tie)

S3, only if S1 and S2 keep < 3: a pass set aside only by the anchor gates of one or two formats (their zeros line's departure or span, their random anchor's span; the tie as in S2) is restored for the OTHER formats' items; the failing formats' items in that pass, anchors included, stay out. Each format's D is over its own zeros line and its r over its own random anchor, so a gate on one format's anchors says nothing of another's. A claim is scored only if every format it reads has >= 3 passes in the reading (claims_types), else NOT SCORED; a pairing across formats (C4) uses only passes that keep both
Never restored in any step: a pass with more than 2 failed runs, a pass whose config read is not card 1's 65/65, a pass whose block did not end ok, an .attempt-* directory

The restored passes' values come from the relaxed reduction (--relax-anchors at the same frozen slope), whose per-pass values equal the primary's for every pass both keep (a fixed slope makes each pass's reduction independent of the others; selftest_e131.py checks it to 1e-12 on E112b's passes)
Fewer than 3 passes after S3: every claim and cross-card rule NOT SCORED
No pass is added after any reduction is read, and no pass is chosen after the fact; every reading (S1, S2, S3) is always reported, and the verdicts name the reading that carries them
set_aside_rule.why: E112(b) kept two of three passes: its third (11252) departed from its fp32 zeros line by -0.253 W against E78's 0.25 W, at every leakage arm, and the spare did not fit, so nothing was scored (E112 README result 3). Over the 15 committed primary reductions of E78-frame passes on card 1 (73 passes), 6 passes were set aside, every one by an anchor gate of one or two formats: four by a zeros line's departure (0.253-0.297 W against 0.25), two by a random anchor's span in E82's dips-kept primary; none by the tie, failed runs or a config read (docs/reports/data/2026-11-02-e131-real-tiles-card1/desk/history-card1.txt). So S3 would have restored five of the six for the other formats

claims.what: E95's frozen claims C1-C12 (claims.E95 of real2/predictions-real2.json) on the card-1 view, scored by score_e95.score unchanged, C7 and C8 by score_e112b's ports (the view's scaled thresholds); E95's conventions: fewer than 3 kept passes NOT SCORED, a claim short of its population UNDER-RESOLVED; beside every verdict, labelled and never the verdict, the same claim at the frozen thresholds unscaled

cross_card.against: E95's committed reductions of aifoundry3 card 0 (frozen by sha256 and commit), as E112b registered them. PRIMARY PAIRING: E131's verdict-carrying reading (dips removed, leakage 0.2414 W/C, card 1's frame) against E95's registered dips-removed arm (dips-arm/e95-nodips.json: dips removed, leakage auto 0.299 W/C, five passes): each card at its own slope, as E82's scale was measured (E82 at its own 0.2414 against E78's own 0.1994). Reported pairings, a verdict that moves marked arm-sensitive: E131 auto against E95 nodips (E112b's primary pairing), E131 dips kept against E95's registered primary (both dips kept), E131 at 0.1994 / 0.3803 / 0 against E95's arms at the same slope, E131 at 0.545 against E95 nodips

X1.name: rank
X1.what: Spearman rho of D(card 1) against D(aifoundry3) within each type, over E95's tiles of that type and the type's random kind
X1.pass_if: rho >= 0.90 in each type (E82's threshold); X1 passes only if all three do; a type with fewer than 75% of its set resolved on both cards is NOT SCORED

X4.name: the real2 tiles share E82's card scale
X4.what: median over the eligible tiles of D(aifoundry3, E95) / D(card 1, E112b), E82's orientation
X4.band_source: E91-X4's band: E82's measured median 1.0308 +- 0.030 (2.5x the 1.2% sd of E82's per-kind ratios)
X4.eligible_rule: tiles whose D in E95's registered primary is >= 5 W (E82's eligibility was a predicted >= 5 W); chosen from aifoundry3's committed numbers only

X5.name: each tile's ratio to random replicates
X5.what: per tile, r = D(tile)/D(random) per pass (E95's convention), mean over kept passes on each card; a tile agrees if |r(card 1) - r(aifoundry3)| <= its band
X5.band_source: about 3x (floats) and 2.3x (int8) the largest |difference| of E91's nine GPT-2 tiles between card 1 and aifoundry3 (fp32 0.011, fp16 0.005, int8 0.026; E91 README result 1)
X5.pass_if: >= 80% of resolved tiles agree; FAIL if < 60%; else INCONCLUSIVE; NOT SCORED with fewer than 26 of the 33 tiles resolved on card 1

cross_card.renamed: E112b-X1, E112b-X4, E112b-X5 are scored by score_e112b.cross() unchanged and reported as E131-X1, E131-X4, E131-X5

cross_card_power.what: make_predictions_e112.simulate unchanged at 4 and 5 passes (E112 registered 3): card 1 drawn from E95's dips-removed means and per-pass scatter, five worlds, 4,000 draws, seed 112

session_tie.what: reported, never a verdict (E95-S1's form): the session's anchors against E82's card-1 cells (E91-R5's and E112b's cells and bands)

cross_session_reported.what: reported, never a verdict: each tile's D and r beside E112b's two kept passes on this card (b-e95-card1/e112b.json, leakage auto 0.417) and E131's auto arm beside them, like with like

expected_not_lines.claims: If E112b's two kept passes and its labelled three-pass post-hoc view carry (E112 README result 4; at E112b's auto slope): C1 FAIL (GPT-2's fp16 attention cell), C7 and C8 INCONCLUSIVE, the other ten PASS; X1, X4, X5 PASS (rho 0.993 / 0.973 / 0.967; X4 median 1.0432; 33 of 33 tiles within X5's bands). E95 on aifoundry3: 9 PASS, 1 FAIL (C1), 2 INCONCLUSIVE (C2, C5), 1 UNDER-RESOLVED (C7). These are expectations, not lines
expected_not_lines.slope: at 0.2414 W/C card 1's D of the hottest tiles reads about 0.4-0.5 W higher than at E112b's auto (D is linear in the slope, E112 README result 2), so X4's median should move toward E82's 1.031
